## 2. Methodology

The default `scan()` verdict at threshold 0.55. Recall and benign FPR are measured on independent pools (no shared prevalence), reported separately rather than as one F1. The threshold is the shipped default, not tuned to the eval set; every number is regenerated from a committed artifact; the hand-curated canary set is not a headline (see Appendix A).

## 7. Limitations

- Lowest-recall categories: E2 0.0%, C1 24.0%, O1 30.0%, P1 35.0%, E1 48.0%.
- No Recall@fixed-FPR, ROC/PR, confusion matrix, or over-defense metric yet; no public agent-injection benchmarks (AgentDojo, INJECAGENT, AdvBench, garak) reported.
- Known-gap `xfail` tests document attacks the engine is expected to miss.
